relations: As she bends elbows, clenched fists descend toward shoulders while her feet widen apart into a broader stance.
Extending arms upward keeps fists closed, then opening hands produces flat spread palms raised overhead.
The mirror reproduces each arm and stance change as a synchronized front-facing reflection.
Fixed camera and ceiling track lights frame the continuous motion, preserving the dancer's identity.
caption: The video captures a woman seen from behind in a bright dance studio, with her mirror reflection facing the camera on the right. She wears a neon-yellow tank top, a blue skirt with a black belt and red cloth at the hip, and matching leg warmers. Her arms are stretched overhead with fists clenched. She bends her elbows to draw the fists down toward shoulder height, holding the flexed position as her feet move apart into a wider stance. She then extends her arms back upward, keeping the fists closed, before opening them into flat, spread palms raised overhead. The mirror reproduces each arm and body change as a synchronized front view while the fixed camera and ceiling track lights frame the continuous mid-action sequence.
